digest.component_or_area: live DC harness and rich-text reconciliation
propositions: Live DC harness must render rich-text bodies to HTML via ?expand=renderedFields and assert that Markdown constructs (# heading, **bold**, {code} macro) produce correct wiki markup in rendered output (h1, b/strong, pre tags)
State-based echo-safety requires a second reconcile pass against converged DC instance to emit no inbound description change when Jira echoes the locally-pushed rich body back as rendered wiki

Both-sides concurrent edit conflict scenario (local edit + Jira edit to description before next pass) must emit local-wins behavior with rebar's body preserved and remote value recorded via deduped outbound-field-conflict:<key>:description alert
InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text must maintain stable public signature and shape so breaking changes are caught by cross-repo contract test before agentic-dev-platform import fails
Inbound differ must apply codec-aware echo-suppression (_description_forms / _text_matches) to recognize Jira's wiki echo of locally-pushed Markdown and suppress spurious re-sync
DC cutover flag (REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER) must enable WikiTextCodec rich-text rendering in the reconciliation subprocess so to_wire converts Markdown to wiki syntax (# -> h1., ** -> *)
